text: The setup task waits until #searchRow0 has its plus button before filling row values and clicking that button. The predicate establishes existence of that exact control after opening the search window. It does not establish visibility, focus or full widget completion. No browser run or intermittent-failure cure was verified.
title: Search-window setup waits for the first row plus button
